clues: This small city sits in the south of La Rioja Province, in Argentina. It is the chief town of its department.
Rain falls most in the hot months of the year. The long dry stretch is mild, snow is rare, and hail falls often.
A test center for flight and space work was founded here in 1961. It is run by the Argentine Air Force.
This town is called the tango hub of its whole province. Tango is the famed dance and music of the land.
Outside town lies La Salina, a long, flat field of salt. It is one of the wild sights folks come to see.
